description: Models the chat can use (DS012 'Formalizer models' and 'Chat modes'). `capabilities` says which chat modes offer a model: `formalize` (SOP Lang; fine-tuned formalizers and the configured endpoint only), `chat` and `translate` (the unmodified base instruct models, which cannot write SOP Lang). A `gguf` entry runs on demand in a CPU llama-server and a `service` entry (a local script serving the same chat-completion interface, such as the symbolic baseline) runs on demand on the CPU (at most three managed models at once); a formalizer gets the message-only prompt of the evaluation harness. The `runtime-endpoint` entry is the independently started endpoint of the runtime configuration (formalizer.url). `default` is the default formalizer and `defaults` the default model per mode. Paths are relative to the repository root.

models.note: Fine-tuned formalizer, run fv1-size-a4, Q8_0. Smallest and fastest arm of experiment formalizer-size-v1.

models.label: SymbolicLM (Stanza + translation + rules)
models.note: SymbolicLM (lib/symbolic-lm/, DS021 'SymbolicLM'): the Stanza 1.10.1 English/Romanian parse (Apache-2.0) and the deterministic UD-to-SOP rules lib/ud-to-sop/, calling lib/languages-util/ for per-token Romanian/English language identification and the symbolic spelling corrector (off by default) and lib/translator-service/ for Romanian-to-English translation (the `symbolic` backend, from the Romanian Stanza parse and the host dictionary). Monolingual Romanian and English messages are parsed directly, mixed messages go through English (route `translate`, Q-PIPE-1, 2026-09-30); values stay verbatim message spans and what the rules cannot place is an unparsed wire. Message-only input, no neural model. Needs ~/nlp-venv with Stanza and its models (dependencies.md). CPU, 4 threads. Replaces the earlier `ud-rules` entry (baseline-ud-rules-v1).

rewrite.note: OPTIONAL SymbolicProofingLLM rewrite of the English text ahead of the rules (SymbolicProofingLLM is the former 'proofreader'; the run id and paths stay frozen) (DS021 'Uncertainty and the rewrite hook'), off by default; this field is metadata only (documents the option), not read by any code path -- `tools/symbolic-lm.mjs serve --rewrite-url <endpoint> [--rewrite-when always|uncertain]` is the actual switch, and it stays off unless that flag is passed explicitly. `gated` = rewriteWhen 'uncertain' (SymbolicLM's own built-in signal), `always` = every English-text row. Evidence: experiment eval-proofreader-e2e-v1 (status/preregistrations/eval-proofreader-e2e-v1.json), a positive end-to-end strict-accuracy gain (CI excludes 0) on formalizer-v1 and formalizer-ood-v1 EN rows, a null/futile effect on the independently-written formalizer-wild-v1 EN rows; RO monolingual (route direct) has no English text and is out of scope.

candidate_backend.model: SymbolicProofingLLM: gemma3-270m (fine-tuned, formerly the proofreader; run train-proofreader-gemma270m-v1)
candidate_backend.serving: llama-server GGUF Q8_0 export (--jinja), message-only chat completion, matching training's prompt exactly
